title: Agent or Human? Detecting Commits by AI Coding Agents in the Absence of Authorship Signatures
abstract: arXiv:2610.36229v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot coding agent, and Cursor now commit directly to open-source repositories. Empirical studies of these agents identify their commits through authorship signatures, such as bot accounts and Co-authored-by trailers. These signatures are optional, can be removed, and are often attached to pull requests rather than to individual commits. Hence, it is unclear whether Agent commits can be told apart from Human commits once the signatures are gone. We investigate the signals and limits of signature-free detection using 7,837,946 commits from 1,226 repositories, covering five coding agents and Human commits. After signatures are masked, detectors rank Agent commits above Human commits with a ROC AUC of up to 0.859, and most of this signal comes from message verbosity and change size rather than from the code itself. On the shared sample, gpt-6-sol without fine-tuning reaches AUCs similar to XG

translated_title: 智能体还是人类？在缺失作者身份签名的情况下检测AI编程智能体的提交
translated_abstract: 诸如 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 编程智能体和 Cursor 等 AI 编程智能体现在可以直接向开源仓库提交代码。针对这些智能体的实证研究通常通过作者身份签名（如机器人账号和 Co-authored-by 尾注）来识别它们的提交。然而，这些签名是可选的、可以被移除的，并且通常附加在拉取请求上而非单个提交上。因此，一旦签名消失，能否将智能体提交与人类提交区分开来尚不清楚。我们使用来自 1,226 个仓库的 7,837,946 个提交（覆盖五个编程智能体及人类提交），研究了无签名检测的信号与局限。在签名被掩盖后，检测器对智能体提交的评分排名高于人类提交，ROC AUC 最高可达 0.859，而且大部分信号来自提交信息的冗长度和变更规模，而非代码本身。在共享样本上，gpt-6-sol 在不进行微调的情况下达到了与 XG（摘要在此处被截断，后续内容缺失）……
tldr: 该研究基于近800万个提交发现，即使去除作者身份签名，仍可凭借提交信息冗长度和变更规模等特征以最高0.859的ROC AUC区分AI编程智能体与人类的代码提交，且检测信号主要来自元数据而非代码本身。
en_tdlr: Even without authorship signatures, AI coding agent commits can be distinguished from human commits with up to 0.859 ROC AUC, with most of the detection signal coming from message verbosity and change size rather than the code itself.
